title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. Σ = Σ^∨(0) is a space carrying a 'locally cylindrical' stratification, where strata look locally like corners, i.e. like a product of half-lines. Γ_0 = Σ^∨(1) is the space of germs of codimension-1 strata at points of Σ. Over Σ it is étale-like: the next page asks that it be proper and a local homeomorphism. More generally Γ(d) = Σ^∨(d+1) is the space of germs of codimension-(d+1) strata. Together with Σ = Γ(∅) (the augmentation) these form an augmented semi-simplicial space over Σ.

The page shows how to recover this semi-simplicial space from Γ_0 → Σ plus an 'ordered' structure.

(i) Form the relative fibre powers Γ_0^{×_Σ d}. Remove the images of the 'half-diagonal' maps coming from lower powers. The result Γ'(d) is the space of ordered d-tuples of pairwise distinct germs of codimension-1 strata at a point of Σ.

(ii) In a corner-like local model, any d distinct local codimension-1 germs meet in a codimension-d germ. Once an order is fixed, Γ(d) is identified with the open (and closed) subset of increasing tuples in Γ'(d). Sorting gives (35): Γ'(d) ≅ 𝔖_d × Γ(d). So Γ'(d)/𝔖_d ≅ Γ(d), the space of unordered d-element sets of local branches.

(iii) A total relative order on Γ_0/Σ is an open-closed subset Γ_1 ⊂ Γ_0 ×_Σ Γ_0 minus the diagonal, meant to be the graph of x<y. It must satisfy Γ_1 ∪ ^sΓ_1 = complement of the diagonal and Γ_1 ∩ ^sΓ_1 = ∅. Equivalently, it is a section of the double cover (Γ_0×_ΣΓ_0 ∖ diag) → Sym²_Σ(Γ_0)^* ('choose a first element among two distinct ones'). It must also satisfy transitivity (36): the subset (Γ_1×_ΣΓ_0) ∩ (Γ_0×_ΣΓ_1) ⊂ Γ_0×_ΣΓ_0×_ΣΓ_0, sent by pr_13 to Γ_0×_ΣΓ_0, must land in Γ_1.

Purpose. The face operators between the Γ(d) come from this order (as on the previous page). Grothendieck wants to rebuild the 'déploiement' (unfolding) spaces of the stratification from the data (Σ, Γ_0, Γ_1). On the next page he admits he has mixed set-theoretic, semi-simplicial and topological aspects, and restarts with Σ as a topological poset.
errors: Index slip: Γ(d) is defined as Σ^∨(d+1) (germs of codim d+1 strata), yet it is described as ordered sequences of d germs of codim-1 strata. Consistently it should be (d+1)-tuples, or Γ(d) should be Σ^∨(d).

Fibre products over Σ are sometimes written as absolute products (Γ_1 ∪ ^sΓ_1 = Γ_0×Γ_0∖diag; target of pr_13). The ambient of (36) is written 'Σ_0×Γ_0×Γ_0' (with an overwritten first symbol) but should be Γ_0×_ΣΓ_0×_ΣΓ_0.

The claim that Γ(d) is open and closed in Γ'(d), giving (35), silently uses the local corner model: every set of distinct local codim-1 germs meets in a stratum of the expected codimension. It is not stated as a hypothesis on this page.

ideas.what: Encoding a locally cylindrical (corner-like) stratification by the étale space Γ_0→Σ of local codim-1 strata germs, its fibre powers minus diagonals, and an augmented semi-simplicial space Γ(d)=Σ^∨(d+1)
ideas.modern_name: semi-simplicial resolution by local branches (cf. normalised intersections D̃^{(k)} of a normal crossings divisor; corner spaces C_k(X) of manifolds with corners)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (Théorie de Hodge II, 1971) for NCD; Joyce / Melrose for corners of manifolds with corners

ideas.what: Γ'(d) ≅ 𝔖_d × Γ(d): ordered distinct tuples of branches versus strata, once a total order on branches is chosen
ideas.modern_name: trivialisation of the 𝔖_d-torsor of orderings of local branches

ideas.what: Relative total order on an étale space over Σ, given as an open-closed subset Γ_1 (a section of the double cover over Sym²_Σ minus diagonal) with fibrewise transitivity
ideas.modern_name: total order object / sheaf of totally ordered sets internal to spaces over Σ

ideas.what: Reconstructing unfolding spaces ('déploiement') of a stratified space from ordered local stratum data
ideas.modern_name: unzipping / resolution of stratified spaces into manifolds with corners
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ayala–Francis–Tanaka (2017, conically smooth spaces); earlier Mather / Thom control data
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme mentions 'dévissage' of stratified structures and tame topology in general terms only

missed.claim: The page treats local codim-1 strata germs of a cylindrically stratified space exactly as branches of a normal crossings divisor or boundary faces of a manifold with corners. Higher strata are recovered as unordered sets of distinct branches, with an order supplying semi-simplicial face maps. This anticipates the C_k(X) formalism for manifolds with corners and the unzipping of stratified spaces, set in a purely topological-stratified context.
missed.quote: les suites ordonnées de d germes de strates de codim 1 en un point, distinctes ... Γ'(d) ≃ 𝔖_d × Γ(d)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a minor historical precursor, part of Grothendieck's unpublished 1981-82 'déploiement' programme alongside AFT unzipping and Joyce's corner functor. The mathematics on this page itself is elementary.

deep.surprise_reason: The page carefully but routinely formalises ordered local branches of a corner-type stratification as a semi-simplicial space over Σ. It is interesting only as part of the unpublished déploiement programme; the content itself is standard.
transcription_corrections: The symbol below the left side of (36) is an inclusion '⊂' rotated (subset of the triple fibre product), not '∩'. The ambient should read Γ_0×Γ_0×Γ_0 (first symbol overwritten), not 'Σ_0×Γ_0×Γ_0'.
Margin reads roughly 'Γ_1 sera le graphe de la relation x<y' rather than 'Γ_1 sur le graphe'.
In 'à la fois ouverte et fermée de Γ'(d)', the word 'fermée' appears to be written (possibly struck) on the next line; the transcription places it ambiguously.
'il faut[?]': the image shows 'suffit' struck out, with a replacement word written above.
